source_claim: The official Harry Potter encyclopedia identifies Newt Scamander and lists his appearances in the Fantastic Beasts films; the official Niffler entry explicitly places Nifflers in Newt's case. The official Harry Potter encyclopedia also has a Sorting Hat entry. Warner Bros. Games' official Hogwarts Legacy material names Sebastian Sallow as a companion/student character. The official Harry Potter site identifies Tom Marvolo Riddle as the person who became Lord Voldemort.
notes: Exact first-party sources for the separate HOME roots: https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/newt-scamander (Newt and his Fantastic Beasts film appearances), https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/creatures/niffler (Nifflers and Newt's case), https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/objects/the-sorting-hat (Sorting Hat), https://www.harrypotter.com/features/unravelling-the-riddle-of-tom (Tom Riddle), and Warner Bros. Games' official Sebastian Sallow trailer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3dYpTuFFP3s plus the official Wizarding World article https://www.harrypotter.com/features/all-the-hogwarts-legacy-characters-we-know-about (Hogwarts Legacy). The campaign spans related but distinct Copyright works, so each relation uses its own directly supported work root.
